title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
summary: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, different modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To examine this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment ($S^2$), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that $S^2$ correlates positively with downstream robot task success across embodied model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. $S^2$ can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones even before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, $S^2$ offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With $S^2$, we extend PRH to embodied models and make sensorimotor alignment empirically measurable, offering insight into why an embodied model succeeds beyond its closed-loop success rate.
tldr: This paper proposes Sensorimotor Alignment (S^2), a training-free offline metric measuring alignment between sensory representations and physical motion geometry, showing it correlates with downstream robot task success and can serve as a cheap proxy for model capability before costly fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出传感器运动对齐（S^2），一种无训练的离线指标，衡量感觉表征与物理运动几何之间的对齐程度，并证明其与下游机器人任务成功率相关，可作为微调前模型能力的低成本代理。
summary_zh: 机器人基础模型通常通过代价高昂的闭环 rollout 进行评估，这促使人们寻求廉价的离线代理指标来评估模型能力。柏拉图式表征假说（PRH）指出，随着表征的改进，视觉和语言等不同模态会趋同于一个共享的现实统计模型。我们提出一个问题：运动轨迹是否构成另一种此类模态——随着具身模型能力的增强，其感官表征是否应趋同于物理运动的结构？为探究此问题，我们提出了感知运动对齐（$S^2$），一种无需训练的离线指标，用于衡量模型感官表征与物理运动几何结构之间的对齐程度。我们发现，$S^2$ 与下游机器人任务成功率在各类具身模型家族中呈正相关，因此可作为低成本离线代理，用于在闭环评估前对模型进行优先级排序。$S^2$ 还能在昂贵的微调为视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）之前，识别出有前景的视觉-语言模型（VLM）骨干网络。除相关性外，$S^2$ 还为 VLA 和世界动作模型（WAM）中观察到的现象提供了表征层面的解释。借助 $S^2$，我们将 PRH 扩展到具身模型，并使感知运动对齐可在经验上度量，从而为理解具身模型为何能超越其闭环成功率提供洞见。

title: Progress Probes $P^2$: Lightweight Runtime Monitoring for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can perform diverse manipulation tasks directly from visual observations and natural language instructions, but they remain prone to mistakes and unpredictable failures. Deploying these policies without continuous human supervision will require robust runtime monitors that detect when the policy has gone off-course. Existing monitors use external foundation models, such as vision-language models (VLMs) to supervise the policy, introducing significant complexity and computational cost for monitoring at runtime. In this work, we investigate an alternate approach: \textit{can a VLA's own internal activations provide the information needed to monitor its execution?} Our method trains linear probes on policy activations from demonstrations to estimate progress, then flags executions that deviate from expected progress. In experiments with the open-source VLA $π_{0.5}$ and across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, this approach is competitive with or outperforms VLM-based monitors in task failure detection, as well as methods which require failure data for training. These findings suggest that simple probes of VLA internals can be used to develop reliable runtime monitors, opening a path toward building policies that can act reliably and monitor their execution without external foundation models.
tldr: This paper introduces Progress Probes, a lightweight runtime monitor for VLA policies that leverages internal activations to detect task failures without external foundation models or failure data, matching or outperforming VLM-based monitors in simulated and real-world manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Progress Probes，一种轻量级VLA策略运行时监控方法，利用策略内部激活信号来检测任务失败，无需外部基础模型或失败数据，在仿真和真实操作任务中性能优于或媲美基于VLM的监控器。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够直接从视觉观察和自然语言指令中执行多种操作任务，但仍容易出错并出现不可预测的故障。在缺乏持续人工监督的情况下部署这些策略，需要稳健的运行时监控器，以便在策略偏离正轨时及时检测。现有的监控器依赖外部基础模型（如视觉-语言模型，VLM）来监督策略，这给运行时监控带来了显著的复杂性和计算成本。在本研究中，我们探索了一种替代方法：\textit{VLA自身的内部激活是否能够提供监控其执行所需的信息？}我们的方法利用示范数据中的策略激活训练线性探针来估计进度，然后标记偏离预期进度的执行过程。在基于开源VLA $π_{0.5}$的实验中，涵盖模拟及真实世界操作任务，该方法在任务失败检测方面与基于VLM的监控器表现相当或更优，同时优于需要失败数据进行训练的方法。这些发现表明，对VLA内部结构的简单探针可用于开发可靠的运行时监控器，为构建无需外部基础模型即可可靠执行并监控自身策略的路径开辟了方向。

title: FastHarness: Experience-Driven Review Scheduling for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Agentic robot systems combine language-model reasoning with robot policies to monitor execution and recover from failures. However, reviewing every action chunk incurs substantial overhead, even in familiar situations. We introduce FastHarness, an experience-driven execution harness that adaptively schedules GPT-6 Astra supervision of a π0.5 policy. A fast path uses stage memory and reviewed outcomes to reduce review frequency as experience accumulates, while a complementary recovery path focuses supervision on correcting errors. Once recovery is verified, routine execution resumes, with failure experience retained to guide future interventions. The policy remains frozen and generates fresh actions from current observations. Across four simulated manipulation tasks, reviewer token use decreases by an average of 57.2% per task from the first evaluated episode to the mean of the final five episodes. Mean episode time decreases from 85.5 to 52.0 minutes over the same interval. On the same tasks, mean success increases from 80% for GPT-as-Policy (π0.5 + GPT-6 Astra) to 97.19% with FastHarness. These results highlight adaptive supervision as a practical route to more efficient agentic robotics without additional model training.
tldr: FastHarness is an experience-driven execution harness that adaptively schedules GPT-6 Astra supervision of a π0.5 policy, reducing reviewer token use by 57.2% and increasing success from 80% to 97.19% on simulated manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: FastHarness 是一种经验驱动的执行框架，自适应调度 GPT-6 Astra 对 π0.5 策略的监督，在模拟操作任务中将审查令牌使用量减少 57.2%，成功率从 80% 提升至 97.19%。
summary_zh: 智能体机器人系统将语言模型推理与机器人策略相结合，以监测执行过程并从故障中恢复。然而，即使在熟悉的情境中，对每个动作块进行审查也会带来大量开销。我们引入了FastHarness，一种基于经验的执行框架，能够自适应地调度GPT-6 Astra对π0.5策略的监督。快速路径利用阶段记忆和已审查结果，随着经验积累降低审查频率，而互补的恢复路径则将监督集中于纠正错误。一旦恢复得到验证，常规执行即恢复进行，同时保留失败经验以指导后续干预。策略保持冻结状态，并根据当前观测生成新的动作。在四项模拟操作任务中，从首个评估回合到最终五个回合的平均值，审查器的令牌使用量平均减少了57.2%。在同一时间段内，平均回合时间从85.5分钟降至52.0分钟。在相同任务中，平均成功率从GPT作为策略（π0.5 + GPT-6 Astra）的80%提升至使用FastHarness后的97.19%。这些结果突显了自适应监督作为一条实用路径，能够在不进行额外模型训练的情况下实现更高效能的智能体机器人系统。

title: LocoManiLab: A Unified Testbed for Data, Policies, Controllers, and Deployment in Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid robots must coordinate locomotion and manipulation in everyday environments, yet progress is difficult to assess across differing policies, controllers, and task settings. LocoManiLab provides an integrated testbed spanning data collection and generation, policy training, evaluation, and physical deployment. Its task suite covers 234 atomic and compositional tasks across five household scene categories, supported by 51.5 hours of simulated teleoperation. The evaluation covers twelve policies with a shared controller across task and scene splits and perturbation levels, two policies across five controllers, and studies of demonstration scale and data-source mixtures. Success rates fall on unseen tasks and scenes and generally decline as visual perturbations increase, with differences in generalization and robustness across policies. For data generation, a humanoid motion generation model is fine-tuned for loco-manipulation to study the alignment of its outputs with task execution requirements and its integration into the data generation pipeline. Three simulated loco-manipulation tasks closely match real-world setups, enabling evaluation of three policies in both domains. Similar policy rankings support the reliability of simulation-based evaluation.
tldr: LocoManiLab is a unified simulation-to-real testbed for humanoid loco-manipulation, providing a task suite, data pipeline, policy/controller evaluation, and deployment validation across both simulation and real robots.
tldr_zh: LocoManiLab 是一个统一的仿真到现实的人形机器人移动操作测试平台，提供任务集、数据流程、策略/控制器评估以及仿真和真实部署验证。
summary_zh: 人形机器人在日常环境中必须协调运动与操作能力，然而，在不同策略、控制器及任务设置下，难以评估其进展。LocoManiLab 提供了一个集成测试平台，涵盖数据采集与生成、策略训练、评估及物理部署。其任务套件涵盖五个家庭场景类别的 234 项原子任务和组合任务，并得到 51.5 小时模拟遥操作数据的支持。评估涵盖十二种策略（在共享控制器下，跨任务与场景划分及扰动级别）、两种策略（跨五种控制器），以及演示规模和数据源混合的研究。成功率在未见任务和场景中有所下降，且通常随视觉扰动增加而降低，不同策略在泛化能力和鲁棒性上表现出差异。在数据生成方面，针对运动-操作任务微调了一个人形运动生成模型，以研究其输出与任务执行要求的一致性及其在数据生成流程中的集成。三个模拟运动-操作任务与实际设置高度匹配，使得三种策略能够在两个领域中进行评估。相似策略排名支持了基于模拟评估的可靠性。

title: When One Step Is Enough: An Empirical Study of Euler Integration in Flow-Matching Policies
summary: Flow matching is now the dominant approach for vision-language action (VLA) robot policies, thanks to its expressiveness and simple training objective. However, inference for standard flow matching requires iteratively solving an ODE, limiting the control frequency at deployment. While several works have proposed novel methods to allow for single-shot action generation, we ask whether such additional objectives are actually necessary. We find that across six flow matching VLAs, one-step action generation largely matches multi-step sampling at scale: multi-step integration confers little to no consistent advantage at inference. We empirically find that this holds as long as models are sufficiently trained and have enough capacity. Practically, the implication is that for large VLAs, the single-step policy comes essentially for free from the multi-step model, enabling low-latency deployment without retraining, distillation, or auxiliary objectives.
tldr: This paper empirically investigates whether multi-step ODE integration in flow-matching VLA policies is necessary, finding that one-step generation matches multi-step performance at scale, enabling low-latency deployment without extra training objectives.
tldr_zh: 本文实证研究了流匹配VLA策略中多步ODE积分是否必要，发现在大规模下单步生成与多步性能相当，可实现无需额外训练目标的低延迟部署。
summary_zh: 流匹配现已成为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）机器人策略的主流方法，这得益于其强大的表达能力和简洁的训练目标。然而，标准流匹配的推理过程需要迭代求解常微分方程，这限制了部署时的控制频率。尽管已有若干工作提出了新颖的方法以实现单步动作生成，我们不禁要问：这些额外的目标是否真的必要？我们的研究发现，在六种流匹配VLA模型中，单步动作生成在规模上基本能够与多步采样相媲美：多步积分在推理时带来的优势微乎其微，甚至不具有一致性。实验结果表明，只要模型经过充分训练且具备足够的容量，这一结论便成立。从实践角度来看，这意味着对于大型VLA模型，单步策略几乎无需额外成本即可从多步模型中自然获得，从而无需重训练、蒸馏或辅助目标即可实现低延迟部署。

title: TerraTransfer++: Demonstration-Free End-to-End Planner
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving has achieved state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks and real-world deployments. Its standard training recipe, however, is expensive across all existing paradigms: imitation learning requires fleet-scale driving logs whose behavior distribution only thinly covers the safety-critical tail; closed-loop reinforcement learning in a photorealistic simulator, while offering diverse behaviors, is bottlenecked by sample-efficiency, per-step cost of rendering, and a forward pass through a large vision backbone. Self-play in vectorized simulators changes the economics: at millions of rollout steps per second, one can obtain a state distribution with natural diversity in collisions, near-misses, and recoveries that no driving log contains, and a highly reactive policy emerges from a basic driving-quality reward. Our approach exploits this asymmetry. We pretrain a single policy by self-play, distill its rollouts into a flow-matching trajectory teacher that also plans, and train lightweight adapters on a frozen pretrained vision backbone to reproduce the latent space of either teacher through the action KL divergence, a batch-relational low-rank structural loss, and, for the planner, a trajectory-matching loss. Every target traces back to the self-play policy, so alignment never supervises against a logged trajectory: a paired dataset of (image, scene-state) frames suffices, with no need for the curated expert demonstrations that imitation pretraining is built on. From this one self-play teacher we obtain two end-to-end students: a closed-loop policy that outperforms every published imitation-based end-to-end method on the photorealistic 3D Gaussian splatting closed-loop benchmark HUGSim, and a planner that reaches 59.4 EPDMS on NAVSIM navhard, above every published method including DriveZero-Scale (57.1), and 95.5 PDMS on navtest, without human demonstrations.
tldr: TerraTransfer++ proposes a demonstration-free end-to-end autonomous driving planner and closed-loop policy, pretrained via self-play in a vectorized simulator and transferred to real-world inputs using lightweight adapters, achieving state-of-the-art results on HUGSim and NAVSIM benchmarks without human demonstrations.
tldr_zh: TerraTransfer++ 提出了一种无需人工演示的端到端自动驾驶规划器与闭环策略，通过在向量化模拟器中自博弈预训练，并利用轻量级适配器迁移到真实输入，在 HUGSim 和 NAVSIM 基准上达到了最先进水平。
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶已在基准测试和实际部署中达到了最先进的性能水平。然而，其标准训练流程在所有现有范式中都代价高昂：模仿学习需要车队规模的驾驶日志，其行为分布仅能稀疏覆盖安全关键的尾部场景；在逼真模拟器中进行闭环强化学习虽然能提供多样化的行为，却受制于样本效率、每步渲染成本以及大型视觉骨干网络的前向传播开销。在向量化模拟器中进行自我对弈改变了这一成本格局：凭借每秒数百万步的 rollout 能力，可以获得包含碰撞、险情和恢复场景中天然多样性的状态分布——这些是任何驾驶日志都无法提供的——并且仅凭基本的驾驶质量奖励即可涌现出高度反应性的策略。我们的方法利用了这种不对称性。我们通过自我对弈预训练单一策略，将其 rollout 蒸馏为同时具备规划能力的流匹配轨迹教师模型，并在冻结的预训练视觉骨干网络上训练轻量级适配器，通过动作 KL 散度、批量关系型低秩结构损失，以及针对规划器的轨迹匹配损失，再现任一教师模型的潜在空间。每个目标最终都追溯到自我对弈策略，因此对齐过程从不针对记录的轨迹进行监督：仅需配对的（图像，场景状态）帧数据集即可，无需模仿预训练所依赖的精选专家示范。从这一自我对弈教师模型中，我们获得了两个端到端学生模型：一个闭环策略，在逼真的 3D 高斯泼溅闭环基准 HUGSim 上超越了所有已发表的基于模仿的端到端方法；以及一个规划器，在 NAVSIM navhard 上达到 59.4 EPDMS，超越包括 DriveZero-Scale（57.1）在内的所有已发表方法，并在 navtest 上达到 95.5 PDMS，全程无需人类示范。

title: DRILL: Training World Models to Improve Policies, Not Predict Pixels
summary: World models are increasingly used to reduce environment interaction when post-training vision-language-action (VLA) policies with reinforcement learning. Yet they are typically trained to predict pixels one step ahead, even though their role here is not merely to render visually faithful videos but to produce learning signals from imagined rollouts that improve the policy. We show that this mismatch is substantial: lower pixel MSE can produce worse policy gradients, and a world model trained for policy utility can yield better downstream policies despite 17% higher pixel MSE on the next frame. We propose the Downstream-Return Imagination Learning Loop (DRILL), a bilevel framework that updates the world model to maximize the policy's return after an inner GRPO update on imagined rollouts. DRILL has two instantiations. DRILL-VWI is a closed-form surrogate, requiring no additional simulator rollouts, that reweights prediction errors by policy visitation, the group-relative GRPO advantage, and model confidence. DRILL-IMG is a full meta-gradient method that differentiates through the inner update using truncated Hessian-vector products. We show that DRILL-VWI recovers the local one-step component of the DRILL-IMG meta-gradient under score-compatibility and small-residual assumptions. Across five manipulation simulators and two VLA backbones, DRILL-IMG raises mean success rate by 13.1 points over WMPO and 7.9 points over RLVR-World, and complements RLVR pretraining rather than competing with it. More broadly, we believe video world models for VLA reinforcement learning can be productively trained by the policy gradients they produce, not only by pixel-level prediction.
tldr: DRILL trains world models for VLA reinforcement learning by maximizing downstream policy returns rather than minimizing pixel prediction error, yielding better downstream policies with worse pixel MSE. Two instantiations are proposed: a closed-form surrogate and a full meta-gradient method, evaluated across five manipulation simulators.
tldr_zh: DRILL通过最大化下游策略回报而非最小化像素预测误差来训练用于VLA强化学习的世界模型，在像素MSE更差的情况下也能获得更好的下游策略。提出了两种实现：闭式代理和完整元梯度方法，并在五个操作模拟器上进行了评估。
summary_zh: 世界模型越来越多地被用于在通过强化学习对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略进行后训练时减少环境交互。然而，这些模型通常被训练用于逐像素的前一步预测，尽管它们在此处的作用并不仅仅是渲染视觉上忠实的视频，而是从想象展开中产生能够改进策略的学习信号。我们表明，这种错配是显著的：更低的像素均方误差（MSE）可能产生更差的策略梯度，而一个为策略效用训练的世界模型尽管在下一帧像素MSE上高出17%，仍能带来更好的下游策略。我们提出下游回报想象学习循环（DRILL），这是一个双层框架，通过在想象展开上进行内部GRPO更新后，更新世界模型以最大化策略的回报。DRILL有两种实例化方式。DRILL-VWI是一种闭式替代方法，无需额外的模拟器展开，通过策略访问频率、组相对GRPO优势以及模型置信度对预测误差进行重新加权。DRILL-IMG是一种完整的元梯度方法，利用截断的Hessian-向量积对内部更新进行微分。我们表明，在分数兼容性和小残差假设下，DRILL-VWI能够恢复DRILL-IMG元梯度的局部一步分量。在五个操作模拟器和两个VLA骨干网络上，DRILL-IMG相比WMPO平均成功率提高了13.1个百分点，相比RLVR-World提高了7.9个百分点，并且与RLVR预训练互补而非竞争。更广泛地说，我们相信，用于VLA强化学习的视频世界模型可以有效地通过它们所产生的策略梯度来训练，而不仅仅是依靠像素级预测。

title: Foundation4D: Towards a unified perception and reconstruction model for autonomous vehicles
summary: We introduce Foundation4D, a unified feed-forward model for geometry estimation, 3D detection, semantic occupancy, and Gaussian reconstruction from multi-camera driving video. A shared backbone uses factorized spatiotemporal attention to efficiently combine observations across cameras and time. Our video inference pipeline uses pose graph optimization to refine camera trajectories and assembles object tracks across input windows. We also develop a data annotation pipeline and release PAI-Foundation4D, a benchmark with dense depth and semantic occupancy labels for 1,253 driving clips. With benchmark-specific fine-tuning, Foundation4D achieves the lowest depth AbsRel on Waymo and nuScenes, the highest detection mAP on nuScenes, and the highest occupancy mIoU on OpenOccupancy among the compared methods. Our task-combination study shows benefits for both detection and geometry: co-training detection with geometry and occupancy improves top-class mAP by 1.2 points over detection-only training, while co-training geometry with detection reduces camera-to-rig translation error by $13.4\%$ relative to geometry-only training. We further use the predicted geometry and trajectories as priors for lidarless NuRec, supporting reconstruction of driving scenes for simulation.
tldr: Foundation4D is a unified feed-forward model for multi-camera driving video that jointly performs geometry estimation, 3D detection, semantic occupancy prediction, and Gaussian reconstruction, achieving state-of-the-art results on several benchmarks and enabling lidarless reconstruction for simulation.
tldr_zh: Foundation4D 是一个用于多摄像头驾驶视频的统一前馈模型，联合进行几何估计、3D检测、语义占据预测和高斯重建，在多个基准上取得了最先进的结果，并支持无激光雷达的驾驶场景重建用于仿真。
summary_zh: 我们提出了Foundation4D，一个统一的逐前馈模型，用于从多摄像头驾驶视频中进行几何估计、3D检测、语义占用和三维高斯基元重建。共享骨干网络采用分解的时空注意力机制，高效地融合跨摄像头和跨时间的观测信息。我们的视频推断流程利用位姿图优化来精化相机轨迹，并跨输入窗口组装目标轨迹。我们还开发了一套数据标注流程，并发布了PAI-Foundation4D基准数据集，包含1,253段驾驶片段的密集深度和语义占用标签。在针对各基准的微调后，Foundation4D在Waymo和nuScenes数据集上取得了最低的深度AbsRel误差，在nuScenes上取得了最高的检测mAP，在OpenOccupancy上取得了最高的占用mIoU，均优于对比方法。我们的任务组合研究表明，检测与几何联合训练对两者均有增益：与仅检测训练相比，联合训练检测与几何和占用可将顶级类别mAP提升1.2个百分点；而与仅几何训练相比，联合训练几何与检测可将相机到车体的平移误差相对降低13.4%。我们还利用预测的几何和轨迹作为无激光雷达NuRec的先验信息，支持驾驶场景的重建以用于仿真。

title: OpenTac: An Open Ecosystem for Customizable, Scalable, and Transferable 3D Tactile Sensing
summary: We present OpenTac, a novel sensor and a full-stack ecosystem for tactile skins that are highly customizable, scalable, and readily deployed in downstream robot control and learning applications. Our core contribution is twofold. First, we develop a scalable resistive tactile skin with a structured deformable overlay that converts tangential loading into spatially varying pressure. Differential responses across neighboring "taxels" support decoding of local shear vectors, and the common-mode response encodes normal force. Second, we provide a highly customizable sensor design tool that is able to automatically generate fabrication files for these tactile skins from 2D outlines and developable 3D surfaces, including from abstract descriptions such as text (e.g., "design a sensor for a size 9 shoe insole"). We develop an ecosystem around the OpenTac sensor, including the CAD design tool, a sensor simulator, cross-sensor transfer, and fast/adaptive data acquisition. We demonstrate the broad applicability of the OpenTac-CAD sensor design tool by designing and fabricating more than 30 sensors across a variety of robot embodiments. We characterize the three-dimensional tactile fields produced by OpenTac with a commercial, high-precision force/torque sensor. We demonstrate the broad applicability of 3D tactile sensing across contact-rich feedback control and manipulation policy learning on four real-world robot embodiments. Additionally, adaptive acquisition enables kilohertz-rate partial readouts, exceeding full-array raster scanning on the same sensor by 19.2X at 16 sampled taxels per update for a 1024-taxel skin. We provide all hardware, software, and result videos are at opentac.github.io
tldr: OpenTac presents a customizable, scalable, and transferable resistive 3D tactile sensing ecosystem with a CAD design tool, simulator, and adaptive readout, demonstrated on multiple real robot embodiments for contact-rich control and manipulation learning.
tldr_zh: OpenTac 提出一个可定制、可扩展且可迁移的电阻式三维触觉传感生态系统，包含 CAD 设计工具、仿真器和自适应读取，并在多种真实机器人上展示了接触丰富的控制与操作学习。
summary_zh: 我们提出了OpenTac，一种新型传感器及全栈生态系统，用于高度可定制、可扩展且可直接部署于下游机器人控制与学习应用中的触觉皮肤。我们的核心贡献有两个方面。首先，我们开发了一种可扩展的电阻式触觉皮肤，其带有结构化可变形覆盖层，能够将切向载荷转换为空间变化的压力。相邻“taxels”（触觉单元）之间的差分响应支持局部剪切矢量的解码，而共模响应则编码法向力。其次，我们提供了一种高度可定制的传感器设计工具，能够从二维轮廓和可展开的三维曲面自动生成这些触觉皮肤的制造文件，包括从文本等抽象描述生成（例如，“为9码鞋垫设计一个传感器”）。我们围绕OpenTac传感器构建了一个生态系统，包括CAD设计工具、传感器模拟器、跨传感器迁移以及快速/自适应数据采集。我们通过设计并制造超过30种适用于不同机器人形态的传感器，展示了OpenTac-CAD传感器设计工具的广泛适用性。我们使用商用高精度力/力矩传感器对OpenTac产生的三维触觉场进行了表征。我们在四个真实机器人平台上展示了三维触觉传感在接触丰富的反馈控制与操作策略学习中的广泛适用性。此外，自适应采集实现了千赫兹级的部分读出，对于1024个taxels的皮肤，每次更新采样16个taxels时，其速度比同一传感器上的全阵列栅格扫描快19.2倍。我们提供了所有硬件、软件及结果视频，详见opentac.github.io。

title: Humanoid Mobility via Attention-based Contacts
summary: Humanoid mobility over complex terrain requires accurate foot placement and coordinated whole-body motion capable of robust adaptation. Reinforcement learning (RL) policies trained without motion references generalize well across terrains, yet eliciting effective whole-body coordination through reward design and exploration alone remains challenging. In contrast, reference-based methods yield natural motions but struggle to adapt beyond the predefined trajectories in their training data. We introduce a learning framework that bridges these two approaches by using motion data strictly as a training prior. An explicit, self-supervised, attention-based contact planner predicts future body-environment contacts, while a contact-conditioned tracker translates these plans into coordinated whole-body motion. Together, they establish contact as an interface between sensory observations and control actions. This abstraction allows the policy to internalize the contact-aware structure of locomotion rather than directly replicating kinematics. Consequently, a single policy can exploit data-driven motion priors for natural whole-body coordination while retaining the flexibility to discover environment-dependent behaviors through reinforcement learning. Building on the learned contact planner and tracker, a subsequent fine-tuning stage bootstraps their acquired capabilities to explore environment variations beyond those covered by the original motion data. Operating entirely from onboard observations without any reference inputs at deployment, this framework enables versatile humanoid mobility in challenging environments.
tldr: This paper introduces a learning framework for humanoid mobility that uses motion data only as a training prior. An attention-based contact planner predicts future body-environment contacts, and a contact-conditioned tracker translates these into whole-body motion, enabling a single policy to combine data-driven natural coordination with RL-driven adaptability, operating without reference inputs at deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种人形机器人移动的学习框架，将动作数据仅用作训练先验。基于注意力的接触规划器预测未来身体与环境的接触，而接触条件跟踪器将这些计划转化为全身运动，使单一策略能够结合数据驱动的自然协调与强化学习驱动的适应性，部署时无需参考输入。
summary_zh: 类人机器人在复杂地形中的移动需要精确的落脚点规划以及能够稳健适应的全身协调运动。未使用运动参考训练的强化学习策略在跨地形泛化方面表现良好，但仅通过奖励设计和探索来激发有效的全身协调仍具挑战性。相比之下，基于参考的方法能够生成自然运动，但难以在训练数据中预定义轨迹之外进行适应。我们提出了一种学习框架，将这两种方法衔接起来，其核心思想是仅将运动数据用作训练先验。一个显式的、自监督的、基于注意力的接触规划器负责预测未来身体与环境的接触点，而一个接触条件跟踪器则将这些规划转化为协调的全身运动。二者共同将接触确立为感觉观测与控制动作之间的接口。这种抽象使策略能够内化运动中的接触感知结构，而非直接复制运动学特征。因此，单一策略既能利用数据驱动的运动先验实现自然的全身协调，又能保留通过强化学习发现依赖环境行为的灵活性。在学习得到的接触规划器与跟踪器基础上，后续的微调阶段利用其已获得的能力，进一步探索超出原始运动数据覆盖范围的环境变化。该框架在部署时完全依靠机载观测，无需任何参考输入，从而能够在挑战性环境中实现类人机器人的多功能移动能力。

title: Echo: Coupled Action and Task Status Signal Denoising for Vision Language Action Models
summary: Recognizing task completion and failure enables robots to stop upon success and initiate recovery or replanning after failure. Existing methods augment Vision Language Action (VLA) policies with task status signal prediction to support these execution decisions. However, learning and integrating these signals can require fine-grained supervision, external monitoring models, or complex architectural designs. Moreover, the potential of task status signals to directly guide action generation remains underexplored. We present Echo, a framework that combines task status signal learning without frame-level progress annotations with a compact design for status prediction and action generation within a single VLA. Specifically, Echo represents task status with stop and failure signals, added as two dimensions of each action chunk and denoised together with robot actions. Their combination distinguishes ongoing execution, successful completion, and failure. To learn these signals without fine-grained progress annotations, Echo constructs successful, failed, and recovery trajectories with complementary supervision properties. To enable status signal-guided action generation, Echo controls interactions between the signals and actions and denoises the signals faster than the actions. These allow later action denoising steps to condition on cleaner status estimates while preserving accurate signal prediction. Extensive real-world manipulation experiments show that Echo accurately predicts task status and consistently improves policy performance.
tldr: Echo introduces a VLA framework that jointly denoises stop/failure status signals with robot actions, enabling status-guided action generation without fine-grained progress annotations and improving real-world manipulation performance.
tldr_zh: Echo 提出一种VLA框架，将停止/失败状态信号与机器人动作联合去噪，无需细粒度进度标注即可实现状态引导的动作生成，并在真实操作任务中提升性能。
summary_zh: 识别任务完成与失败使机器人能够在成功时停止操作，并在失败后启动恢复或重新规划。现有方法通过增强视觉语言行动（VLA）策略，加入任务状态信号预测来支持这些执行决策。然而，学习并整合这些信号可能需要细粒度的监督、外部监控模型或复杂的架构设计。此外，任务状态信号直接引导动作生成的潜力仍未得到充分探索。我们提出Echo框架，该框架在无需帧级进度标注的情况下结合任务状态信号学习，并在单一VLA中实现状态预测与动作生成的紧凑设计。具体而言，Echo以停止信号和失败信号表征任务状态，将其作为每个动作块的两个维度，与机器人动作一同去噪。二者的组合区分了执行进行中、成功完成和失败三种状态。为了在没有细粒度进度标注的情况下学习这些信号，Echo构建了具有互补监督特性的成功、失败和恢复轨迹。为了实现状态信号引导的动作生成，Echo控制信号与动作之间的交互，并使信号的去噪速度快于动作。这使得后续动作去噪步骤能够基于更清晰的状态估计进行条件生成，同时保持准确的信号预测。大量真实世界操作实验表明，Echo能够准确预测任务状态，并持续提升策略性能。

title: Skeleton-Grounded Latent Action Model for Robot World Models
summary: Robot world models simulate how environments evolve in response to robot actions. Latent action models enable learning dynamics from videos by encoding visual transitions as proxy actions. However, reconstruction-driven latent actions mix robot motion with object responses and other scene changes, complicating their correspondence with robot controls. We propose SkeLAM, a skeleton-guided latent action model for controllable robot world modeling. SkeLAM decomposes latent actions into a kinematic component grounded by robot skeleton supervision and a residual component retaining complementary visual dynamics. Cross-modal swap reconstruction encourages RGB-derived and skeleton-derived kinematic representations to be interchangeable during video reconstruction. The world model incorporates both components through separate conditioning pathways, while branch dropout reduces its dependence on future-derived residual information. A lightweight adapter maps robot actions to the kinematic space, and subsequent world-model fine-tuning adapts generation to these predicted conditions. At inference, the model generates future observations from the current observation and robot actions. On DROID, SkeLAM reduces end-effector ADE by 19.5% and LPIPS by 11.1% compared with DreamDojo. Motion probing supports kinematic specialization, while qualitative results demonstrate zero-shot human-to-robot motion transfer in generated rollouts. Policy evaluation shows agreement between predicted success rates and those measured in real robot executions.
tldr: SkeLAM decomposes latent actions in robot world models into robot skeleton-grounded kinematic components and residual visual dynamics, enabling action-conditioned future video generation and improved policy evaluation on DROID.
tldr_zh: SkeLAM将机器人世界模型中的潜在动作分解为基于骨架的运动学成分和残差视觉动态成分，从而在DROID上实现动作条件未来视频生成并改进策略评估。
summary_zh: 机器人世界模型模拟环境如何响应机器人动作而演变。潜动作模型通过将视觉状态转换编码为代理动作，实现了从视频中学习动态过程。然而，基于重建驱动的潜动作将机器人运动与物体响应及其他场景变化混合在一起，使得其与机器人控制的对应关系变得复杂。我们提出SkeLAM，一种骨架引导的潜动作模型，用于可控机器人世界建模。SkeLAM将潜动作分解为基于机器人骨架监督的动力学组件和保留补充视觉动态的残差组件。跨模态交换重建促使源自RGB和源自骨架的动力学表征在视频重建过程中可互换。世界模型通过独立的条件路径整合两个组件，而分支丢弃机制则减少其对源自未来的残差信息的依赖。一个轻量级适配器将机器人动作映射到动力学空间，随后的世界模型微调使生成过程适应这些预测条件。在推理时，模型根据当前观测和机器人动作生成未来观测。在DROID数据集上，与DreamDojo相比，SkeLAM将末端执行器平均位移误差降低了19.5%，学习感知图像块相似度降低了11.1%。运动探测实验支持动力学特化，定性结果表明生成的滚动视频中实现了零样本的人到机器人运动迁移。策略评估显示预测成功率与实际机器人执行测得的成功率一致。

title: VecTile: A Low-Cost Flexible Tactile Array for 3-DoF Force Sensing
summary: Tactile sensing provides robots with contact information difficult to obtain from vision alone. Shear force is particularly important for understanding tangential contact, guiding corrective motions, and maintaining grasp stability, yet flexible and low-cost tactile arrays often measure only normal force. We introduce VecTile, a low-cost, 6 mm thin, flexible tactile array capable of three-axis force sensing. VecTile combines a piezoresistive layer with passive silicone nubs that convert normal and shear forces into distinguishable pressure patterns. The sensor can be fabricated in-house without specialized equipment. The complete system costs less than 35 USD for a 4x4 array. We validate the sensing mechanism through finite element analysis and hardware experiments. In controlled single-taxel tests over 1-5 N normal force and up to 1.5 N shear force, VecTile achieves root-mean-square errors of 0.39 N and 0.16 N for normal and shear forces. A VecTile calibrated while flat retains accuracy when curved, while a five-minute manual calibration is sufficient for practical use. Two applications demonstrate its utility. First, shear readings are sensitive enough to stop a sharp scalpel from puncturing a balloon after contact. Second, the sensor substantially improves Diffusion Policy-guided power-plug insertion. All designs and code will be released upon paper acceptance. Project website: https://jiannnh.github.io/VecTile/.
tldr: VecTile is a low-cost, flexible tactile array that measures 3-axis forces (normal and shear) using piezoresistive layers and passive silicone nubs, validated in robot manipulation tasks like preventing scalpel puncture and improving diffusion-policy-guided plug insertion.
tldr_zh: VecTile 是一种低成本、灵活的触觉阵列，通过压阻层和被动硅胶凸点测量三轴力（法向和剪切），并在机器人操作任务中验证，如防止手术刀刺破气球和改善扩散策略引导的插头插入。
summary_zh: 触觉感知能够为机器人提供仅依靠视觉难以获得的接触信息。其中，剪切力对于理解切向接触、引导修正动作以及维持抓取稳定性尤为重要，然而柔性且低成本的触觉阵列通常仅能测量法向力。我们提出了VecTile，一种低成本、厚度仅6毫米的柔性触觉阵列，具备三轴力感知能力。VecTile将压阻层与被动式硅胶凸点相结合，能够将法向力和剪切力转换为可区分的压力分布图案。该传感器无需专门设备即可在实验室内部制作完成，一套4×4阵列的完整系统成本低于35美元。我们通过有限元分析和硬件实验验证了该感知机制。在受控的单税元测试中，法向力范围为1–5 N、剪切力最高达1.5 N时，VecTile对法向力和剪切力的均方根误差分别为0.39 N和0.16 N。在平直状态下标定的VecTile在弯曲后仍能保持精度，而五分钟的手动标定即可满足实际使用需求。两项应用展示了其实用性：其一，剪切力读数灵敏度足以在接触后阻止锋利的手术刀刺穿气球；其二，该传感器显著提升了基于扩散策略的电源插头插入操作的成功率。所有设计和代码将在论文接收后公开发布。项目网站：https://jiannnh.github.io/VecTile/。

title: FocusVLA: Future-Intent Guided Dynamic View Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become an important paradigm for robotic manipulation by unifying visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Since reliable manipulation requires sufficient observation of objects, end-effectors, and their spatial relationships, multi-view inputs are widely used to provide complementary spatial information. However, our experiments show that existing VLA models do not fully exploit such multi-view complementarity. The policy tends to persistently rely on the wrist view, lacking the ability to dynamically adjust global-local view dependency across manipulation stages, which limits stage adaptability and robustness. To address this issue, we propose FocusVLA, a stage-aware multi-view routing framework. FocusVLA predicts future interaction intent from historical actions and uses it to guide dynamic view routing during action generation. By adaptively coordinating global and local observations across different task stages, FocusVLA improves multi-view utilization. On RoboTwin 2.0, FocusVLA improves the average success rate over the strongest baseline $π_{0.5}$ by 10.10 pp. In real-world evaluation, FocusVLA improves the success rate from 71.7\% to 85.0\%, achieving a 13.3\% gain over $π_{0.5}$. Moreover, the intent prediction and dynamic routing modules of FocusVLA can be integrated into existing VLA frameworks without modifying their core architectures.
tldr: FocusVLA proposes a stage-aware multi-view routing framework for VLA models, using future interaction intent predicted from historical actions to dynamically coordinate global and local views, improving manipulation success rates on RoboTwin 2.0 and real-world evaluations.
tldr_zh: FocusVLA提出一种针对VLA模型的阶段感知多视角路由框架，通过从历史动作预测未来交互意图，动态协调全局与局部视角，提升RoboTwin 2.0及真实世界的操控成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过统一视觉感知、语言理解与动作生成，已成为机器人操作领域的重要范式。由于可靠的操作需要对物体、末端执行器及其空间关系进行充分观测，多视角输入被广泛用于提供互补的空间信息。然而，我们的实验表明，现有VLA模型并未充分利用这种多视角互补性。策略倾向于持续依赖腕部视角，缺乏在操作各阶段动态调整全局-局部视角依赖的能力，这限制了阶段适应性和鲁棒性。针对这一问题，我们提出了FocusVLA，一种阶段感知的多视角路由框架。FocusVLA从历史动作中预测未来交互意图，并利用该意图指导动作生成过程中的动态视角路由。通过在不同任务阶段自适应协调全局与局部观测，FocusVLA提升了多视角的利用效率。在RoboTwin 2.0上，FocusVLA相较于最强基线$\pi_{0.5}$将平均成功率提升了10.10个百分点。在真实世界评估中，FocusVLA将成功率从71.7\%提升至85.0\%，相较于$\pi_{0.5}$取得了13.3\%的提升。此外，FocusVLA的意图预测与动态路由模块可集成到现有VLA框架中，无需修改其核心架构。

title: Memory before Goal: Role of Pre-History Memory for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation in dynamic scenes is non-Markovian: cues vanish as objects change or are hidden, or leave the view as the robot turns and walks, yet whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies see only the present. We present WholeBodyMem, an object-guided perceptual memory that keeps the pre-history of object events seen before the robot acts on its goal. SAM3 tracks the task objects, and their events causally select key frames within an adaptive budget, which the action expert reads by cross-attention together with object tokens encoding appearance, geometry and time. We also contribute HuMeGo, a humanoid memory benchmark with six simulated and six real-world Unitree G1 tasks. Keeping the right frames rather than more frames, WholeBodyMem surpasses memoryless and uniform-memory baselines, raising its base policy's success from 29.1% to 72.6% in simulation and from 36.7% to 88.3% on the real robot, while also improving the standard SIMPLE tasks (70.2% to 86.9%).
tldr: WholeBodyMem introduces an object-guided perceptual memory for humanoid loco-manipulation VLAs, using SAM3-based event selection and cross-attention to retain pre-history object frames, significantly improving success rates in simulation and real robots.
tldr_zh: WholeBodyMem 为类人机器人全身操作提出了一种对象引导的感知记忆，通过 SAM3 事件选择和交叉注意力保留目标物体的历史帧，显著提升了仿真和真实机器人的成功率。
summary_zh: 动态场景中的人形机器人全身操作-移动任务具有非马尔可夫性：当物体发生变化或被遮挡时，相关线索会消失，或者当机器人转身行走时目标会离开视野，而现有的全身视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略仅能感知当前状态。为此，我们提出WholeBodyMem——一种目标引导的感知记忆机制，能够在机器人执行目标动作之前，保存所观测到的物体事件的历史信息。SAM3对任务物体进行跟踪，其事件因果性地在自适应预算内选择关键帧，动作专家模型通过交叉注意力机制读取这些关键帧，并结合编码外观、几何和时间信息的物体标记进行融合。此外，我们构建了HuMeGo基准测试集，包含六个仿真环境和六个真实世界Unitree G1任务的人形机器人记忆基准。实验表明，选择正确的关键帧比保留更多帧更为关键，WholeBodyMem在仿真中将基础策略的成功率从29.1%提升至72.6%，在真实机器人上从36.7%提升至88.3%，同时也在标准SIMPLE任务上取得了改进（从70.2%提升至86.9%）。

title: RGraph-Eval: Task-Grounded Scene Graphs for Evaluating Robot Video Generation
summary: Generated robot videos can look convincing while depicting the wrong interac- tion: a different object is moved, a grasp disappears, or a placement ends out- side its destination. We introduce RGraph-Eval, a reference-based framework that makes these discrepancies explicit through task-grounded temporal scene graphs. Unlike approaches that construct separate evidence representations for different evaluation dimensions, we organize task entities, interactions, and motion within a unified, interpretable scene graph representation. A foundation-model pipeline identifies manipulation roles, grounds persistent object masks, infers and verifies state transitions and action intervals, and reconstructs manipulated- object motion in three dimensions. Applying this representation to a generated video and a reference demonstration supports an interpretable RGraph-Eval score with visible-object, relation-change, and 3D path-shape components. We also introduce ShareRobot-SG, a collection of 1,000 manipulation scenes from ten ShareRobot sources annotated with the multimodal representation. Our eval- uation separates graph-generation quality from agreement with human video judgments, and includes comparisons with adapted SVG2 and SG-Ego, a bench- mark of three video generators. The framework connects robot-video assessment to the observable entities and interactions underlying a task, while making the graph annotations reusable beyond evaluation. Code will be publicly available at https://github.com/SashaDance/rgraph-eval.
tldr: RGraph-Eval introduces a reference-based framework using task-grounded temporal scene graphs to evaluate robot video generation, with a new ShareRobot-SG dataset of 1,000 annotated manipulation scenes.
tldr_zh: RGraph-Eval 提出了一个基于任务场景图的参考框架，用于评估机器人视频生成，并包含一个包含 1,000 个操作场景的新数据集 ShareRobot-SG。
summary_zh: 生成的机器人视频虽然看起来令人信服，却可能描绘出错误的交互行为：移动了错误的物体、抓取动作消失，或放置操作超出目标区域。我们提出RGraph-Eval，一种基于参考的评估框架，通过以任务为锚定的时序场景图使这些不一致性显式化。与针对不同评估维度构建独立证据表示的方法不同，我们将任务实体、交互和运动统一组织在一种可解释的场景图表示中。一条基础模型流水线用于识别操作角色、锚定持久物体掩码、推断并验证状态转换和动作区间，以及在三维空间中重建被操作物体的运动轨迹。将该表示应用于生成视频和参考演示，可得到一种可解释的RGraph-Eval评分，包含可见物体、关系变化和三维路径形态三个组成部分。我们还引入了ShareRobot-SG，一个包含来自十个ShareRobot源的1000个操作场景的数据集，并标注了多模态表示。我们的评估将图生成质量与人类视频判断的一致性区分开，并包括与改进版SVG2和SG-Ego的对比，以及针对三个视频生成器的基准测试。该框架将机器人视频评估与任务背后的可观察实体和交互联系起来，同时使图标注在评估之外也具有可复用性。代码将公开于 https://github.com/SashaDance/rgraph-eval。

title: TRACE: Traversability-aware Reactive Navigation via VLM-driven Adaptive Constraints Estimation
summary: This paper presents TRACE, a traversability-aware reactive navigation framework designed for the autonomous operation of ground robots in unstructured forest environments. Unlike traditional approaches, TRACE leverages VLM-based confidence maps from positive and negative natural-language prompt sets and combines them through evidential fusion to produce a dense traversability map that prioritizes the terrain based on signs of previously traversed paths. Traversability-annotated points are then extracted and used to derive the left and right boundaries of the traversable path via percentile binning followed by spline or regularized polynomial fitting. These boundaries are then incorporated as soft barrier constraints within an NMPC formulation, enabling safe and adaptive path following in complex natural environments. Rigorous experimental trials carried out in real-life forest environments demonstrate TRACE ability for smooth navigation in cluttered, deformable, and visually ambiguous terrains.
tldr: TRACE uses VLM-based confidence maps and evidential fusion to create traversability maps for ground robots in forests, then fits navigation boundaries and encodes them as NMPC constraints for reactive, safe path following.
tldr_zh: TRACE 利用基于 VLM 的置信度图和证据融合为地面机器人生成森林环境中的可通行性地图，并通过拟合导航边界并将其作为 NMPC 约束，实现安全、自适应的反应式路径跟踪。
summary_zh: 本文介绍了TRACE，一种用于地面机器人在非结构化森林环境中自主运行的、具有穿越性感知的反应式导航框架。与传统方法不同，TRACE利用基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的置信度图，这些图源自正面和负面的自然语言提示集，并通过证据融合相结合，生成一个密集的穿越性地图，该地图根据先前穿越路径的迹象对地形进行优先级排序。随后，提取带有穿越性标注的点，并通过百分位分箱结合样条或正则化多项式拟合，推导出可穿越路径的左右边界。这些边界作为软约束条件纳入非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）框架中，实现在复杂自然环境中安全且自适应的路径跟踪。在真实森林环境中进行的严格实验测试表明，TRACE能够在杂乱、可变形且视觉模糊的地形中实现平滑导航。

title: UniFlowWAM: A Unified World-Action Model with Visual Semantics and 4D Geometry
summary: Robot demonstrations record what the robot saw and what it did. They do not specify how the 3D world changed in between. Scene-level 3D flow describes it by tracking 3D scene points, providing the world representation with 4D geometry. Prior work has used flow to improve robot policies. Flow served as an intermediate prediction that a separate model converts into actions, as a prior injected at inference time, or as an extra output learned together with the action. In all of these designs, flow stays outside the policy, as a separate module or as an extra prediction head. We introduce UniFlowWAM, a Unified World-Action Model that makes 3D scene flow a third modality on par with vision and action. Its world representation therefore covers both visual semantics, through future visual features, and 4D geometry, through 3D flow, and flow receives its own supervision. UniFlowWAM is a diffusion transformer with one expert per modality, and the three experts exchange information through joint attention. We train UniFlowWAM under a ten-objective role grid, where each objective assigns every modality exactly one of three roles, namely target, condition, or absent. The same model thus serves as a policy, as forward and inverse dynamics, and as a predictor of future visual features or 3D flow. We evaluate UniFlowWAM on RoboCasa-GR1, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus in simulation, and on four real-world bimanual manipulation tasks. On RoboCasa-GR1, UniFlowWAM raises the success rate of its base model without flow from 52.1% to 56.4%. It preserves in-distribution success on LIBERO at 98.1% and reaches 87.7% zero-shot on LIBERO-Plus. On the real robot, it achieves 87.0% average success, compared with 68.5% for the strongest baseline.
tldr: UniFlowWAM introduces a unified world-action model that treats 3D scene flow as a third modality alongside vision and action, using a diffusion transformer with per-modality experts and joint attention, and evaluates on simulated and real manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: UniFlowWAM 将 3D 场景流作为与视觉和动作并列的第三种模态，采用带逐模态专家和联合注意力的扩散变压器，并在仿真和真实操作任务上进行了评估。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
机器人演示记录了机器人所观察到的内容及其所采取的动作，但并未说明三维世界在此过程中如何发生变化。场景级三维流通过追踪三维场景点来描述这种变化，从而为世界表征提供四维几何信息。已有研究利用流信息来改进机器人策略，流可作为中间预测结果由独立模型转化为动作，也可作为推理时注入的先验信息，或作为与动作联合学习的额外输出。在上述所有设计中，流都被置于策略之外，作为独立模块或额外预测头。我们提出UniFlowWAM，一种统一的世界-动作模型，将三维场景流提升为与视觉和动作并列的第三种模态。其世界表征因此既涵盖视觉语义（通过未来视觉特征），又涵盖四维几何（通过三维流），且流信息具有独立的监督信号。UniFlowWAM是一种扩散Transformer模型，每种模态对应一个专家模块，三个专家通过联合注意力机制进行信息交互。我们在十目标角色网格下训练UniFlowWAM，其中每个目标为每种模态分配三种角色之一，即目标、条件或缺失。因此，同一模型可同时充当策略、前向与逆向动力学模型，以及未来视觉特征或三维流的预测器。我们在模拟环境中的RoboCasa-GR1、LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上，以及四项真实世界双臂操作任务上对UniFlowWAM进行了评估。在RoboCasa-GR1上，UniFlowWAM将其无流基线模型的成功率从52.1%提升至56.4%；在LIBERO上保持分布内成功率98.1%，并在LIBERO-Plus上实现87.7%的零样本成功率。在真实机器人上，其平均成功率达87.0%，而最强基线仅为68.5%。

title: IORA: Irregular Object Immobilization under Restricted Actuation
summary: Stable grasping under task-specific disturbances is important for robotic manipulation. However, most dexterous grasp synthesis methods are developed for highly actuated hands in free space, and low-DoF hands may not be able to realize the contact topologies required by these grasps. Meanwhile, support surfaces can provide useful contact forces, but are often treated only as geometric constraints. We present a support-aware grasp synthesis framework for object immobilization with low-DoF coupled hands. Given irregular object geometry, our method represents both hand and object local surface regions as graphs and searches for kinematically feasible matchings between them. We then refine the wrist pose and motor state for geometric contact feasibility and validates the refined grasps through physical rollouts. Starting from the validated grasp pose, an optional task-guided local search explores nearby grasp configurations by varying the wrist pose and motor state, and selects one according to the specified task condition. Experiments on diverse objects show that our method generates various grasp configurations that achieve high grasp success and strong disturbance resistance. Real-world experiments further demonstrate physically executable grasps which enable object immobilization in cooking scenario.
tldr: The paper presents a support-aware grasp synthesis framework for immobilizing irregular objects with low-DoF coupled hands, using graph matching and physical validation to achieve stable grasps under task-specific disturbances.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种支持感知的抓取合成框架，用于低自由度耦合手对不规则物体的固定，通过图匹配和物理验证实现任务干扰下的稳定抓取。
summary_zh: 针对特定任务扰动下的稳定抓取对于机器人操作至关重要。然而，大多数灵巧抓取合成方法是为自由空间中的高驱动手部设计的，而低自由度手部可能无法实现这些抓取所需的接触拓扑结构。与此同时，支撑面能够提供有用的接触力，但通常仅被当作几何约束处理。我们提出了一种支持感知的抓取合成框架，用于低自由度耦合手部实现物体固定。给定不规则物体几何形状，我们的方法将手部和物体局部表面区域均表示为图结构，并搜索二者之间运动学上可行的匹配关系。随后，我们优化手腕姿态和电机状态以满足几何接触可行性，并通过物理仿真滚动验证优化后的抓取。从验证通过的抓取位姿出发，可选的任务引导局部搜索通过改变手腕姿态和电机状态来探索邻近的抓取配置，并根据指定的任务条件选择其一。在多种物体上的实验表明，我们的方法能够生成多种抓取配置，实现高抓取成功率和强抗扰动能力。真实世界实验进一步展示了物理上可执行的抓取，能够在烹饪场景中实现物体固定。

title: TEAR: Task-Evidence Authority Routing for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Reliable robotic manipulation in field-deployed settings requires more than executing a capable controller. As the execution conditions change, the system must decide, online and on the robot side, which control source should hold authority. Human teleoperation adapts readily to contact-rich and semantically ambiguous situations but depends on a stable communication link. Local autonomy is executed without continuous human intervention, but may fail under semantic ambiguity, long-horizon drift, and unforeseen contingencies. These two control sources exhibit complementary reliability profiles. We formulate this complementarity as a control authority routing problem and present Task-Evidence Authority Routing for Robotic Manipulation (TEAR), an edge-deployable framework that allocates authority between human teleoperation and local autonomy. TEAR arbitrates on the robot side using network-state evidence, which governs the usability of teleoperation, and task-semantic evidence, which reflects whether autonomous execution remains consistent with the current task. A lightweight temporal arbitrator observes both forms of evidence together with robot state and current authority to time authority transfers. Across simulated and real-world trials under dynamic network conditions, TEAR achieves task success rates close to pure teleoperation while limiting teleoperation to 19.8-27.4% of control steps and improves success by 30-40% over autonomy-only execution in our settings. These results demonstrate the potential of complementary authority routing to sustain successful manipulation with substantially reduced dependence on continuous human control.
tldr: TEAR proposes an edge-deployable framework that routes control authority between human teleoperation and local autonomy for robotic manipulation based on network-state and task-semantic evidence, achieving high success rates with reduced human control under dynamic network conditions.
tldr_zh: TEAR 提出了一种边缘可部署的框架，根据网络状态和任务语义证据在人类遥操作和本地自主之间分配控制权，在动态网络条件下以更少的人类控制实现了高任务成功率。
summary_zh: 可靠的机器人操控在实地部署环境中，不仅仅需要执行一个强大的控制器。随着执行条件的变化，系统必须在机器人端在线决定，哪一种控制源应当拥有决策权。人类远程操作能够灵活应对接触密集和语义模糊的情境，但依赖稳定的通信链路。本地自主执行不需要持续的人类干预，但在语义模糊、长时间跨度漂移以及不可预见的突发情况下可能会失效。这两种控制源展现了互补的可靠性特征。我们将这种互补性形式化为一个控制权路由问题，并提出了任务证据感知的机器人操控控制权路由（TEAR）框架，这是一个可在边缘部署的框架，在人类远程操作与本地自主性之间分配控制权。TEAR在机器人端依据网络状态证据——这决定了远程操作的可用性，以及任务语义证据——这反映了自主执行是否仍与当前任务保持一致，来进行决策仲裁。一个轻量级的时间仲裁者结合机器人状态和当前控制权，观测这两类证据，以确定控制权转移的时机。在动态网络条件下的模拟及实际试验中，TEAR取得了接近纯远程操作的任务成功率，同时将远程操作限制在控制步骤的19.8%至27.4%之间，并且在我们的设置中，相较于仅自主执行，成功率提高了30%至40%。这些结果展示了互补性控制权路由的潜力，可以在大幅减少对持续人类控制依赖的情况下，维持成功的操控执行。

title: Robot Motion Transition with Human Motion Prior
summary: Humanoid motion-tracking policies can reproduce diverse behaviors, yet connecting independently acquired motions into a continuous sequence remains challenging. Interpolation connects boundary poses without considering whether their relative position, heading, and timing provide suitable conditions for a transition. A generative motion prior can produce richer motion, but poorly arranged boundaries may cause it to generate excessive locomotion, turning, or another unintended action. We present Spatio-Temporal Alignment with a Motion Prior (STAMP), a framework for connecting independently acquired humanoid motions through a Robot-to-Human-to-Robot process. STAMP uses human motion space to draw on rich motion priors and reuse transition knowledge across robot embodiments. Its key component is a learned alignment model that determines the boundary conditions for motion inbetweening. Given the two motions retargeted to a human rig, the alignment model ranks candidate positions, headings, and transition durations for the following motion. A human motion prior generates the transition under the selected alignment. The completed sequence is retargeted to the robot and used as a reference to train a motion-tracking policy. We evaluate the tracking success of the generated transitions on Unitree~G1 and~ROBOTIS K1. Physical robot demonstrations further show that STAMP connects independently acquired motions into long-horizon sequences. Project page: https://childtoy.github.io/STAMP-project
tldr: STAMP connects independently acquired humanoid motions into continuous sequences by using a learned alignment model to select boundary conditions (position, heading, duration) and a human motion prior to generate transitions, retargeting back to robots for policy training; validated on Unitree G1 and ROBOTIS K1 with real-robot demos.
tldr_zh: STAMP 通过学习的对齐模型选择边界条件（位置、朝向、时长），并利用人类运动先验生成过渡，将独立获取的人形机器人动作连接成连续序列，再重定向回机器人用于策略训练；在 Unitree G1 和 ROBOTIS K1 上验证并进行了实物演示。
summary_zh: 类人运动跟踪策略能够复现多样的行为，然而将独立获取的运动连接成连续序列仍具挑战性。插值方法仅连接边界姿态，而未考虑其相对位置、朝向及时间是否具备过渡的适宜条件。生成式运动先验能够产生更丰富的运动，但布局不当的边界可能导致其生成过量的位移、转向或其他非预期动作。我们提出时空对齐与运动先验（STAMP），一种通过“机器人—人类—机器人”过程连接独立获取的类人运动的框架。STAMP利用人体运动空间以借助丰富的运动先验，并跨机器人本体复用过渡知识。其关键组件是一个学习型对齐模型，用于确定运动插补的边界条件。在将两段运动重定向至人体骨架后，该对齐模型对后续运动的候选位置、朝向和过渡时长进行排序。人体运动先验在选定对齐条件下生成过渡序列。完整序列被重定向回机器人，并作为参考来训练运动跟踪策略。我们在Unitree G1和ROBOTIS K1上评估了所生成过渡的跟踪成功率。实体机器人演示进一步表明，STAMP能够将独立获取的运动连接成长时域序列。项目页面：https://childtoy.github.io/STAMP-project

title: Adaptive Aerial Loco-Manipulation Policy Learning via LLM-Assisted Proactive Task Generation
summary: Loco-manipulation extends the workspace of conventional manipulation by combining mobility with physical interaction, while aerial loco-manipulation further expands this capability into three-dimensional space, enabling robots to reach environments inaccessible to ground-based systems. Moving to an aerial platform, however, gives rise to a demanding control problem, since the vehicle must track trajectories accurately in three dimensions while the motion of the arm and its interaction with the environment continuously shift the center of mass, alter the inertia, and impose force and moment disturbances on the body. Conventional controllers address these effects through explicit models and estimation, whereas learning-based controllers infer dynamics from experience, yet control rewards provide no direct target for the response information retained from history, and fixed task sampling can leave persistent tracking difficulties insufficiently explored. We present ALMA, an aerial loco-manipulation framework for adaptive flight control under external arm commands. ALMA employs a contextual flight policy that adapts from recent measurements and actions, using action-conditioned prediction of future measurement representations to train its context to retain response information relevant to flight control. To expand the experience available for this adaptation, an evolutionary process uses a large language model (LLM) to analyze observed control difficulties and propose new structures of arm motion for subsequent training. In simulation, ALMA reduces position root-mean-square error (RMSE) by up to 24.7% relative to the strongest baseline, while the same policy transfers zero-shot to the aerial manipulator and reduces hover position RMSE by 79.6% during periodic arm motion relative to the real-world baseline.
tldr: ALMA is an aerial loco-manipulation framework that uses a contextual flight policy with action-conditioned prediction and LLM-assisted evolutionary task generation to adaptively control an aerial manipulator, reducing position error in simulation and real-world zero-shot transfer.
tldr_zh: ALMA 是一种空中移动操控框架，利用上下文飞行策略和 LLM 辅助的进化任务生成，自适应控制空中机械臂，在仿真和真实世界零样本迁移中均降低了位置误差。
summary_zh: 移动操控通过将移动性与物理交互相结合，扩展了传统操控的工作空间，而空中移动操控进一步将该能力拓展至三维空间，使机器人能够到达地面系统无法进入的环境。然而，转向空中平台带来了具有挑战性的控制问题，因为飞行器必须在三维空间中精确跟踪轨迹，同时机械臂的运动及其与环境的交互会持续改变质心位置、改变惯量，并对机体施加力和力矩扰动。传统控制器通过显式建模和估计来应对这些影响，而基于学习的控制器则从经验中推断动力学特性，但控制奖励并未为从历史中保留的响应信息提供直接目标，且固定任务采样可能导致持续存在的跟踪困难未被充分探索。我们提出了ALMA，一种在外部机械臂指令下实现自适应飞行控制的空中移动操控框架。ALMA采用一种上下文飞行策略，该策略根据最近的测量值和动作进行自适应，利用基于动作条件的未来测量表征预测来训练其上下文，以保留与飞行控制相关的响应信息。为扩展该自适应过程可用的经验，一种进化过程使用大语言模型（LLM）分析观察到的控制困难，并为后续训练提出新的机械臂运动结构。在仿真中，ALMA相对于最强基线将位置均方根误差（RMSE）最多降低24.7%，同时相同策略零样本迁移至空中机械臂，并在周期性机械臂运动期间将悬停位置RMSE相对于真实世界基线降低79.6%。

title: Live Thread Reconstruction for Autonomous Manipulation
summary: Autonomous robotic surgery has drawn increased attention in recent years due to its potential to relieve surgeons of time-consuming, mentally straining, and tedious tasks, particularly during prolonged operations. One suitable task for automation is suturing, which involves tracking the thread as it deforms during needle retrieval, de-tangling, knot tightening, and other tasks. Unlike rigid-object manipulation, deformable thread manipulation has no fixed pose to track and effectively infinite degrees of freedom, making its configuration difficult to predict and requiring the thread's state to be re-estimated rather than assumed. At the same time, thread manipulations involve sequential motions that depend on past and current thread contact points, which must be accurately and continuously tracked. This paper presents an image-to-manipulation pipeline that concurrently generates live thread reconstruction while conducting safe and optimized sequential manipulations to achieve long-horizon tasks.
tldr: The paper presents an image-to-manipulation pipeline for autonomous robotic surgery that concurrently reconstructs the live state of deformable threads and performs safe, sequential manipulations for long-horizon suturing tasks, addressing the challenge of tracking and manipulating effectively infinite-degree-of-freedom deformable objects.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于自主机器人手术的图像到操作流程，该流程同时重建可变形线的实时状态，并执行安全、顺序的操作以完成长时间缝合任务，解决了跟踪和操作具有无限自由度的可变形物体这一挑战。
summary_zh: 自主机器人手术近年来受到越来越多的关注，因为其有望减轻外科医生在长时间手术中承担的时间消耗、精神压力大且单调乏味的任务。缝合是适合自动化的任务之一，涉及在针取出、解缠、打结等操作过程中跟踪线材的变形。与刚性物体操作不同，可变形线材操作没有固定的姿态可供跟踪，且具有几乎无限的自由度，使其构型难以预测，因此需要重新估计线材的状态，而非假设其状态。同时，线材操作涉及依赖于过去和当前线材接触点的序列性动作，这些接触点必须被准确且连续地跟踪。本文提出了一种从图像到操作的流水线，该流水线在实时生成线材重构的同时，执行安全且优化的序列性操作，以完成长时程任务。

title: Co^2Gen: Collaboratively Generating Task Plans for Decentralized Multi-Robot and Human Collaboration
summary: Visual Language Action (VLA) models are designed to be generalist robot models that can be implemented across embodiments, tasks and environments. However, their ability to collaborate with other robots and humans remains underexplored. In this work, we propose a framework to automate the generation of multi-robot collaborative data for decentralized VLA training without requiring human teleoperation. Our framework first utilizes a decentralized collaborative planning approach to generate multi-robot collaborative robot plans in the form of an executable function. We then utilize the collaborative plan to produce collaborative demonstration data to finetune VLA models in a decentralized manner. We show that our approach produces demonstration data that when used to finetune VLA models on decentralized collaboration tasks matches the task performance of VLA models finetuned on human-teleoperated collaborative data.
tldr: This paper proposes Co^2Gen, a framework that automatically generates decentralized multi-robot collaborative demonstration data for fine-tuning VLA models, matching the performance of models trained on human-teleoperated data without requiring teleoperation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Co^2Gen框架，自动生成去中心化多机器人协作演示数据以微调VLA模型，性能匹配人工遥控数据微调的模型，且无需人工遥控。
summary_zh: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型旨在成为通用型机器人模型，可跨本体、任务和环境进行部署。然而，它们与其他机器人及人类协作的能力仍未得到充分探索。在本研究中，我们提出了一种框架，用于自动化生成多机器人协作数据，以支持去中心化的VLA训练，且无需人工遥操作。该框架首先采用去中心化协作规划方法，以可执行函数的形式生成多机器人协作计划。随后，我们利用该协作计划生成协作示范数据，以去中心化的方式对VLA模型进行微调。我们表明，所提出的方法生成的示范数据在用于对去中心化协作任务中的VLA模型进行微调时，其任务性能可与基于人工遥操作协作数据微调的VLA模型相媲美。

title: Know When to Escalate: Critic-Guided Adaptive Execution for Cloud-Local Embodied Agents
summary: Recent advances in foundation-model agents have enabled increasingly capable embodied systems for long-horizon planning and interaction. However, embodied agents require fast, closed-loop decisions as they continuously perceive and act on a changing environment. Deploying strong cloud agents leaves the platform idle for seconds between consecutive actions, while lightweight local models respond quickly but are more vulnerable to errors. Existing hierarchical architectures typically assign models fixed roles, whereas conventional model routers make stateless per-request decisions. We present CARE, a critic-guided adaptive execution framework that dynamically determines when to escalate control from a local executor to a stronger cloud model. A lightweight critic model monitors execution reliability and triggers escalation when local execution becomes unreliable; once escalated, control persists until the agent recovers, avoiding step-wise switching. To support such control transfer, a shared handoff memory maintains execution context and task-level progress across executors, enabling the model to intervene without restarting from scratch. Across diverse embodied benchmarks, CARE improves task success by 6.3-18.3 percentage points over the strongest evaluated collaboration baseline. CARE further approaches or exceeds Cloud-only success while reducing median time-between-action latency by 28.8-82.6%.
tldr: CARE is a critic-guided adaptive execution framework that dynamically switches between local and cloud embodied agents, using a lightweight critic to trigger escalation when local execution becomes unreliable and a shared handoff memory to maintain context across executors, improving task success and latency on embodied benchmarks.
tldr_zh: CARE 是一个批评家引导的自适应执行框架，在本地与云端具身智能体之间动态切换，通过轻量级批评家检测本地执行不可靠时触发升级，并利用共享交接记忆保持跨执行器的上下文，从而在具身基准上提升任务成功率并降低延迟。
summary_zh: 近期，基础模型智能体的研究进展使得具身系统在长期规划与交互方面的能力日益增强。然而，由于具身智能体需要持续感知并对不断变化的环境作出反应，因此必须具备快速、闭环的决策能力。在连续动作之间，部署强大的云端智能体可能导致平台闲置数秒，而轻量级本地模型虽然响应迅速，却更易产生错误。现有的分层架构通常为各模型分配固定角色，而传统的模型路由器则做出无状态的逐请求决策。我们提出了CARE——一种基于评论员引导的自适应执行框架，能够动态决定何时将控制权从本地执行器升级至更强大的云端模型。轻量级评论员模型负责监控执行可靠性，并在本地执行不再可靠时触发升级；一旦升级，控制权将持续至智能体恢复状态，从而避免逐步切换。为支持此类控制转移，共享交接内存跨执行器维护执行上下文与任务级进度，使模型能够在无需从头重启的情况下介入。在多个具身基准测试中，CARE相较于最强协作基线方法，任务成功率提升了6.3至18.3个百分点。同时，CARE在接近甚至超越纯云端成功率的前提下，将动作间中位延迟减少了28.8%至82.6%。

title: Motion Retargeting with Spatiotemporal Preferences for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Human motion retargeting bridges the embodiment gap between humans and humanoid robots by converting human demonstrations into reference trajectories for whole-body control and loco-manipulation. For object-interaction tasks, successful execution depends on accurately preserving body--object relations at critical stages. However, uniform per-frame iteration budgets do not account for these localized accuracy requirements, limiting the computational efficiency of retargeting. To address this limitation, we present Spatiotemporal Retargeting (STR), which uses keyframes and key body parts to allocate optimization effort. Specifically, a vision-language model selects relevant motion signals and body parts, and keyframes are identified from changes in the selected signals. Based on these selections, STR assigns additional solver iterations to keyframes and higher interaction weights to the selected parts. To further improve contact fidelity, we introduce Mechanics-Aware Contact Anchoring (MCA) to refine object-surface contact positions using an approximate object-wrench model while retaining the selected surface directions. Building on the resulting references, we develop Spatiotemporal Reinforcement Learning (STRL), which combines adaptive key-stage sampling with a contact reward based on target proximity and object contact forces for downstream control. Simulation experiments on a Unitree G1 and real-world experiments on a Unitree R1 demonstrate that STR improves geometric contact coverage and continuity at lower computational cost, while the resulting references improve downstream task completion across diverse object-interaction motions.
tldr: This paper introduces Spatiotemporal Retargeting (STR), a method that uses vision-language models to allocate optimization effort to keyframes and body parts for efficient and accurate human-to-humanoid motion retargeting, along with Mechanics-Aware Contact Anchoring and Spatiotemporal Reinforcement Learning to improve contact fidelity and downstream task completion in loco-manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出时空重定向（STR）方法，利用视觉语言模型将优化计算分配到关键帧和关键身体部位，结合力学感知接触锚定和时空强化学习，以提高人形机器人运动重定向的效率和接触保真度，并改善下游操作任务的成功率。
summary_zh: 人体运动重定向通过将人类演示转化为全身控制与操作任务的参考轨迹，弥合了人类与仿人机器人之间的具身差异。对于涉及物体交互的任务，成功执行取决于在关键阶段精确保持身体与物体之间的关系。然而，统一的逐帧迭代预算并未考虑这些局部精度需求，从而限制了重定向的计算效率。为解决这一问题，我们提出时空重定向方法（STR），利用关键帧和关键身体部位来分配优化计算资源。具体而言，视觉语言模型选择相关的运动信号和身体部位，并根据所选信号的变化识别关键帧。基于这些选择，STR 为关键帧分配额外的求解器迭代次数，并为所选部位赋予更高的交互权重。为进一步提升接触保真度，我们引入力学感知接触锚定方法（MCA），利用近似的物体力矩模型细化物体表面接触位置，同时保留所选表面方向。基于生成的参考轨迹，我们进一步开发了时空强化学习方法（STRL），将自适应关键阶段采样与基于目标接近度和物体接触力的接触奖励相结合，用于下游控制。在 Unitree G1 上的仿真实验和 Unitree R1 上的实际实验表明，STR 以更低的计算成本提升了几何接触覆盖率和连续性，同时生成的参考轨迹在多种物体交互运动中显著改善了后续任务的完成效果。

title: Self-Distilling Future Video Representations for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising approach to learning generalist robot policies using rich spatiotemporal priors from pre-trained video diffusion models. A recent line of WAMs improves inference efficiency by conditioning a separate action decoder on intermediate future video representations extracted from a single denoising step, avoiding costly iterative denoising required for video generation. This design makes action prediction depend directly on the quality of these future representations. In this paper, we introduce Future REpresentation learning via self-Distillation with temporal context (FRED), a framework that trains WAMs to improve the quality of future video representations from noise in a single denoising step. Specifically, FRED uses self-distillation to predict future representations from noise, using representations extracted from ground-truth future observations as targets. We further condition the video model on historical observations, providing temporal context for predicting future representations better. Across diverse real-world manipulation scenarios, FRED consistently outperforms competing WAMs. It achieves particularly large gains on long-horizon and out-of-domain tasks under zero-shot environment generalization, and substantially improves human-to-robot skill transfer, reaching 50.0% task success on tasks absent from robot training data and demonstrated only in human videos, compared with 19.4% for the best competing WAM.
tldr: FRED improves world action models by self-distilling future video representations from a single denoising step, using ground-truth future observations as targets and conditioning on historical context, leading to strong gains in real-robot long-horizon, out-of-domain, and human-to-robot transfer tasks.
tldr_zh: FRED 通过自蒸馏从单步去噪中改进未来视频表示，以真实未来观测为目标并利用历史上下文，在真实机器人长时程、域外及人机技能迁移任务上取得显著提升。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）已成为一种前景广阔的方法，利用预训练视频扩散模型中的丰富时空先验来学习通用机器人策略。近期一系列WAMs通过将单独的动作解码器以单次去噪步骤中提取的中间未来视频表示为条件，避免了视频生成所需的昂贵迭代去噪过程，从而提高了推理效率。这一设计使得动作预测直接依赖于这些未来表示的质量。在本文中，我们提出了通过带时间上下文的自我蒸馏进行未来表示学习（FRED）框架，该框架训练WAMs在单次去噪步骤中从噪声中提高未来视频表示的质量。具体而言，FRED利用自我蒸馏从噪声中预测未来表示，以从真实未来观测中提取的表示作为目标。我们进一步将视频模型以历史观测为条件，为更好地预测未来表示提供时间上下文。在多样化的真实世界操作场景中，FRED持续优于竞争性WAMs。在零样本环境泛化下的长时域和域外任务上，FRED取得了尤为显著的提升，并大幅改善了人至机器人技能迁移，在机器人训练数据中不存在且仅在人视频中展示的任务上达到了50.0%的任务成功率，而最佳竞争性WAM仅为19.4%。

title: Measuring the Reasoning-Action Coupling in Driving Vision-Language-Action Models through Counterfactuals
summary: Driving vision-language-action (VLA) models bring an appealing form of explainability to a safety-critical domain, since a system that can state the reasons for its maneuvers offers the transparency that deployment and public trust in autonomous driving demand. These models read the world into language before they act on it, describing the scene and reasoning over it in text that ranges from chain-of-thought to multi-stage question answering on the way to a trajectory. That framing quietly assumes two separable properties, namely that the trajectory follows the generated reasoning and that the generated reasoning tracks the causes that actually produce the trajectory. To thoroughly investigate these properties, we apply causal, counterfactual interventions to four driving VLAs across different benchmarks. First, we perturb the models' own reasoning and show that altering its meaning produces small trajectory changes relative to blanking the same models' camera inputs, a pattern that persists across benchmarks and model architectures. We then construct scene-level counterfactuals through photorealistic removal of key objects named in the models' reasoning and analyze whether the generated reasoning and trajectories track these changes. Overall, our findings indicate that the reasoning these models present to account for their resulting driving behavior is weakly coupled to that behavior itself, pointing to limits on the explainability these systems are intended to provide.
tldr: This paper evaluates the coupling between generated reasoning and actual driving trajectories in vision-language-action models for autonomous driving using causal counterfactual interventions, finding that the reasoning is weakly coupled to the driving behavior, thus limiting the models' explainability.
tldr_zh: 本文通过因果反事实干预，评估了自动驾驶视觉语言动作模型中生成推理与实际驾驶轨迹之间的耦合程度，发现推理与驾驶行为耦合较弱，限制了模型的可解释性。
summary_zh:
摘要：
驾驶视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为安全关键领域带来了一种颇具吸引力的可解释性形式，因为能够陈述其驾驶操作理由的系统，正是自动驾驶部署及获取公众信任所要求的透明度体现。这类模型在采取行动之前，先将世界读入语言，以文本形式描述场景并进行推理，其文本形式从思维链到多阶段问答，最终导向轨迹输出。这一框架隐含地预设了两个可分离的性质，即轨迹遵循所生成的推理，以及所生成的推理追踪实际产生轨迹的因果因素。为深入探究这些性质，我们在不同基准上对四种驾驶VLA模型施加了因果反事实干预。首先，我们扰动模型自身的推理，并表明与屏蔽相同模型的摄像头输入相比，改变推理含义所产生的轨迹变化较小，这一模式在不同基准和模型架构中均保持一致。随后，我们通过对模型推理中提及的关键对象进行照片级逼真移除来构造场景级反事实，并分析所生成的推理和轨迹是否追踪这些变化。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，这些模型为解释其最终驾驶行为而呈现的推理与其行为本身耦合较弱，这揭示了这类系统旨在提供的可解释性存在局限。

title: HiSTEVE 1.0: Harnessing Human-Interface VLA Agents for Open-World Games
summary: Building virtual embodied agents that operate in open-ended games like human players is a long-standing goal requiring both long-horizon autonomy and reliable native-interface control. As a procedurally generated open world, Minecraft provides a natural testbed for studying the integration of these capabilities. Existing agents typically provide either native visuomotor control without long-horizon autonomy or high-level planning executed through environment APIs or predefined skills. To bridge this gap, we propose HiSTEVE, a hierarchical VLA agent with a capability-aware agent harness. At the orchestration level, we equip the harness with structured memory for tracking progress and a VLM planner for selecting subtasks within the VLA's capabilities. To reliably determine subtask completion, we further introduce a policy-coupled task completion state detector that conditions on VLA policy context to signal candidate completion. At the control level, a single VLA executes all subtasks with vision-only perception and native keyboard-and-mouse actions. To mitigate interference between heterogeneous GUI and non-GUI interactions, we introduce regime-specific RMSNorm branches and separate mouse-movement token embeddings. We also train the VLA through world knowledge injection, imitation learning, and reinforcement learning with environment feedback to improve reliability and recovery. HiSTEVE achieves state-of-the-art atomic-task performance, scoring 85.0% on MineStudio Bench and a 37.4% average success rate on OpenHA, while also completing long-horizon tasks such as crafting an iron pickaxe from scratch like human players.
tldr: HiSTEVE 1.0 is a hierarchical VLA agent that combines a VLM planner, structured memory, and a policy-coupled completion detector with a single vision-only VLA policy using native keyboard-and-mouse control to achieve long-horizon open-world game tasks in Minecraft, setting state-of-the-art results on MineStudio Bench and OpenHA.
tldr_zh: HiSTEVE 1.0 是一个层级式 VLA 智能体，结合 VLM 规划器、结构化记忆和与策略耦合的完成检测器，通过单一视觉策略和原生键盘鼠标控制在 Minecraft 中实现长时程开放世界任务，在 MineStudio Bench 和 OpenHA 上达到最优。
summary_zh: 构建像人类玩家一样在开放式游戏中运行的虚拟具身智能体是一个长期目标，这既需要长程自主性，也需要可靠的本地接口控制。作为程序化生成的开放世界，Minecraft为研究这些能力的整合提供了天然的试验平台。现有智能体通常要么提供不含长程自主性的原生视觉运动控制，要么通过环境API或预定义技能执行高层规划。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了HiSTEVE，一种具有能力感知智能体框架的层次化VLA智能体。在编排层面，我们为框架配备结构化记忆以追踪进度，并配备VLM规划器以在VLA能力范围内选择子任务。为可靠地判定子任务完成状态，我们进一步引入了一种与策略耦合的任务完成状态检测器，该检测器以VLA策略上下文为条件来提示候选完成状态。在控制层面，单一VLA以纯视觉感知和原生键盘鼠标操作执行所有子任务。为缓解异构GUI与非GUI交互之间的干扰，我们引入了特定模态的RMSNorm分支和独立的鼠标移动令牌嵌入。我们还通过世界知识注入、模仿学习以及带环境反馈的强化学习来训练VLA，以提高其可靠性和恢复能力。HiSTEVE在原子任务上达到了最先进的性能，在MineStudio Bench上得分85.0%，在OpenHA上平均成功率达37.4%，同时还能像人类玩家一样完成从零开始锻造铁镐等长程任务。

title: DeXplicit: Making Physical State Explicit in Dexterous Manipulation World Models
summary:
Before acting on an object, a robot needs to anticipate how its hand motion will change the physical world and what the resulting scene will look like. Existing approaches typically entangle action-conditioned dynamics, camera motion, and visual synthesis within a video generation model, or represent dynamics as point trajectories without explicit object structure. We introduce DeXplicit, a dexterous manipulation world model that instead predicts how the world evolves explicitly in metric 3D before rendering its visual consequences. Given an initial scene and a future hand trajectory, a lightweight 3D dynamics network predicts object-centric motion and deformation, providing structured and geometrically grounded future world states. These predictions then serve as a strong scaffold for video generation: appearance is transported through the predicted 3D motion and projected into future views, allowing the renderer to focus on completing uncertain and newly visible content rather than implicitly learning world dynamics from pixels. This explicit-3D-first decomposition also enables efficient causal generation, requiring only two denoising steps per block while conditioning on generated history.
  Across HOT3D, OakInk2, and PhysTwin, DeXplicit reduces moved-point error by 27-40% relative to PointWorld and improves object fidelity IoU+ by 47% on HOT3D under a shared renderer. Our design with two-step causal generation achieves a 57x speedup from our 14B bi-directional configuration in video synthesis.
tldr: DeXplicit introduces a dexterous manipulation world model that predicts physical state evolution in explicit 3D before rendering visual consequences, improving dynamics accuracy and generation efficiency.
tldr_zh: DeXplicit 提出一种灵巧操作世界模型，在渲染视觉结果前显式预测 3D 物理状态演变，提高了动态准确性与生成效率。
summary_zh: 在对物体采取行动之前，机器人需要预判其手部运动将如何改变物理世界，以及由此产生的场景将呈现何种状态。现有方法通常将动作条件动力学、相机运动与视觉合成缠绕于一个视频生成模型中，或将动力学表示为点轨迹而缺乏明确的物体结构。我们提出DeXplicit，一种灵巧操控世界模型，该模型在渲染视觉结果之前，显式地以度量三维形式预测世界的演化过程。给定初始场景与未来手部轨迹，一个轻量级三维动力学网络预测以物体为中心的运动与形变，提供结构化且具备几何依据的未来世界状态。这些预测随后作为视频生成的强有力支架：外观通过预测的三维运动进行传输并投影至未来视角，使渲染器能够专注于补全不确定及新出现的可见内容，而非隐式地从像素中学习世界动力学。这种显式三维优先的分解方式还实现了高效的因果生成，每个块仅需两步去噪即可在生成历史的条件约束下运行。在HOT3D、OakInk2和PhysTwin数据集上，DeXplicit相较于PointWorld将移动点误差降低了27%-40%，并在共享渲染器下，在HOT3D上将物体保真度IoU+提升了47%。我们的两步因果生成设计相较于14B双向配置，在视频合成上实现了57倍的加速。

title: SmolVLA-MoE: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Multi-Task Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising results in multi-task robotic manipulation by leveraging visual and language understanding for action generation. However, existing lightweight VLA models employ a single dense action expert to handle all tasks, which limits their multi-task capability under constrained computational budgets. To address this issue, we propose SmolVLA-MoE, a novel framework that introduces sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) into the FFN layers of the action expert in VLA models. SmolVLA-MoE replaces dense FFN layers with multiple parallel expert FFNs and a token-level router, enabling each token to adaptively select the most suitable expert for action generation. We further introduce a shared expert with a tunable weight parameter to balance the inheritance of pre-trained capabilities and task-specific expert specialization. Through sparse activation, SmolVLA-MoE activates only a single expert FFN during inference, with a total activated parameter count of approximately 500M including the frozen VLM backbone, while benefiting from approximately 800M total stored parameters. We evaluate our method on four task suites of the LIBERO benchmark. SmolVLA-MoE achieves an average success rate of 84.25%, outperforming SmolVLA (82.75%) and OpenVLA-7B (76.5%), while maintaining comparable inference efficiency. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/dudu435/smolvla-moe.
tldr: SmolVLA-MoE introduces a sparse Mixture-of-Experts design into the action expert of a lightweight VLA model, improving multi-task manipulation performance on LIBERO with minimal added inference cost.
tldr_zh: SmolVLA-MoE 在轻量级 VLA 模型的动作专家中引入稀疏专家混合（MoE）设计，在 LIBERO 基准上提升了多任务操作性能，同时保持相近的推理效率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过利用视觉和语言理解生成动作，在多任务机器人操作中展现出显著效果。然而，现有的轻量级VLA模型采用单一的密集动作专家处理所有任务，这在有限的计算预算下限制了其多任务能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SmolVLA-MoE，一种新颖的框架，将稀疏混合专家（MoE）引入VLA模型动作专家中的前馈神经网络（FFN）层。SmolVLA-MoE用多个并行的专家FFN和token级路由器替代密集FFN层，使每个token能够自适应地选择最适合动作生成的专家。我们进一步引入一个具有可调权重参数的共享专家，以平衡预训练能力的继承与任务特定专家的专业化。通过稀疏激活，SmolVLA-MoE在推理时仅激活单个专家FFN，包括冻结的VLM主干网络在内，总激活参数约为5亿，同时受益于约8亿的总存储参数。我们在LIBERO基准的四个任务套件上评估了我们的方法。SmolVLA-MoE实现了84.25%的平均成功率，优于SmolVLA（82.75%）和OpenVLA-7B（76.5%），同时保持相当的推理效率。我们的代码已在https://github.com/dudu435/smolvla-moe公开。

title: DiffDreamer: Coupling World Models with Differentiable Simulation for Agile Quadrotor Control
summary: Tasks such as quadrotor dynamic-gate racing require agents to anticipate external motion while maintaining precise high-frequency control. World-model-based reinforcement learning provides a natural solution by learning latent dynamics for future imagination, yet it often entangles environmental evolution and the robot's own dynamics in a single learned rollout, where model bias can affect policy optimization efficiency. We propose DiffDreamer, a differentiable reinforcement learning framework that tightly couples a learned world model with differentiable simulation for actor optimization. In one optimization step, the learned world model propagates latent states that capture external dynamics and history-dependent features, while the differentiable simulator propagates the robot's explicit physical state. We further decompose the actor objective into a critic-driven pathway for non-differentiable task rewards and a simulator-driven pathway for differentiable motion rewards. Experiments on aggressive tracking and dynamic-gate racing show that DiffDreamer improves training convergence over the model-free, model-based, and differentiable-RL baselines, and final performance over these baselines and classical planning and control methods. Additional experiments assess reward decomposition and the odometry-conditioned relative-state representation through ablations. We also provide proof-of-concept real-world flight experiments for validation.
tldr: DiffDreamer couples a learned world model with differentiable simulation for quadrotor control, improving training convergence and final performance in aggressive tracking and dynamic-gate racing tasks, with real-world validation.
tldr_zh: DiffDreamer将学习的世界模型与可微分仿真相结合，用于四旋翼控制，在激进跟踪和动态门竞赛任务中提高了训练收敛性和最终性能，并经过实际飞行验证。
summary_zh: 摘要：诸如四旋翼动态门竞速等任务，要求智能体在保持精确高频控制的同时预测外部运动。基于世界模型的强化学习通过学习隐式动力学以实现未来想象，为上述问题提供了自然解决方案，但该方法往往将环境演化与机器人自身动力学耦合在单一的学习展开过程中，导致模型偏差可能影响策略优化的效率。我们提出DiffDreamer，一种可微强化学习框架，将学习到的世界模型与可微仿真紧密耦合，用于智能体优化。在单步优化中，学习到的世界模型传播捕捉外部动力学和依赖历史状态特征的隐状态，而可微仿真器则传播机器人显式的物理状态。我们进一步将智能体的目标函数分解为两条路径：基于评论家的路径处理不可微的任务奖励，以及基于仿真器的路径处理可微的运动奖励。在激进跟踪和动态门竞速实验中的结果表明，DiffDreamer在训练收敛速度上优于无模型、基于模型和可微强化学习基线方法，并在最终性能上超过这些基线方法以及经典规划与控制方法。进一步的实验通过消融研究评估了奖励分解和基于里程计条件的相对状态表示。我们还提供了概念验证的真实世界飞行实验以进行验证。

title: SCOPE: Scene-graph Construction Optimized by Plan Error-correction for Robot Long-term Planning Datasets
summary: Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) stands as a fundamental challenge in robotics, essential for enabling autonomous agents to execute complex, long-horizon tasks in diverse environments. While Large Language Models (LLMs) introduce a new paradigm for TAMP by leveraging extensive common sense, their inherent reasoning limitations hinder direct application, and fine-tuning strategies to enhance these capabilities are currently bottlenecked by the scarcity of high-quality datasets. Existing automated generation methods often suffer from homogeneity, limiting model generalization, and unsolvability, where hallucinated scene graphs create physical mismatches with task goals. To address these issues, we propose Scene-graph Construction Optimized by Plan Error-correction (SCOPE), an automated framework designed to generate diverse and executable TAMP datasets. SCOPE incorporates multi-level diversity metrics to maximize the information entropy of scenarios. Crucially, it introduces a Plan Feedback Error-correction pipeline that utilizes planner execution failures as feedback signals to retroactively rectify logical inconsistencies in scene graphs, ensuring physical feasibility. Experimental results demonstrate that SCOPE exhibits greater robustness to erroneous scene graphs and generates higher-quality data. When utilized for LLM fine-tuning, SCOPE-generated data yield a downstream TAMP model that achieves an absolute 12.33% gain in success rate over its counterpart fine-tuned with data generated by DELTA, a state-of-the-art PDDL-based planner.
tldr: SCOPE is an automated framework that generates diverse and executable Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) datasets for fine-tuning LLMs, using planner execution failures to correct scene-graph inconsistencies and improve downstream plan success rates.
tldr_zh: SCOPE 是一个自动化框架，用于生成多样且可执行的机器人长期规划（TAMP）数据集，通过利用规划器执行失败来修正场景图中的逻辑不一致，从而提升下游 LLM 微调模型的任务成功率。
summary_zh: 任务与运动规划（TAMP）是机器人学中的一项基础性挑战，对于使自主智能体能够在多样化环境中执行复杂的长时域任务至关重要。尽管大语言模型（LLMs）通过利用广泛的常识为TAMP引入了新的范式，但其固有的推理局限性阻碍了直接应用，而增强这些能力的微调策略目前受限于高质量数据集的稀缺。现有的自动化生成方法常常存在同质性问题，限制了模型的泛化能力，以及不可解性问题，即幻觉场景图与任务目标之间产生物理层面的不匹配。为解决这些问题，我们提出了基于计划错误校正优化的场景图构建框架（SCOPE），这是一种自动化框架，旨在生成多样化且可执行的TAMP数据集。SCOPE引入了多层次多样性度量，以最大化场景的信息熵。关键在于，它创新性地提出了一种计划反馈错误校正流水线，利用规划器执行失败作为反馈信号，反向修正场景图中的逻辑不一致性，从而确保物理可行性。实验结果表明，SCOPE对错误的场景图展现出更强的鲁棒性，并能生成更高质量的数据。当用于LLM微调时，通过SCOPE生成的数据所训练的下游TAMP模型，相较于使用当前最先进的基于PDDL的规划器DELTA生成的数据微调得到的模型，成功率绝对提升了12.33%。

title: Point-Level Refinable Semantic Mapping for Spatial Understanding
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D semantic maps have emerged as a key spatial memory representation for long-horizon robot autonomy, enabling robots to reason about objects, their spatial relationships, and past observations across time. However, existing object-centric semantic maps are primarily designed for static environments and rely on an append-only point integration strategy, where newly observed points are accumulated but previously integrated points are rarely reevaluated.
